ask: The company's registration or license number, and its class
Any job-size limit the license has
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
pf.license.holder: The business; plus a qualifying person where the state's form names one. Trade subcontractors (electrical for deck lighting, gas for a fire pit line, concrete footings) hold their own where required.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
blocks: No deck building work goes live until the company's registration or license checks out, where one is required
A job over the license's size limit is never offered or quoted: the owner is told why
pf.license.renewals: License, insurance and bond dates kept; reminded 30 days out; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.design_studio: A consult at the showroom needs no license in most states. The work it leads to is booked under the contractor license.
pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.capacity: One estimator or design advisor per booking; one deck crew per job at a time; the showroom's design table is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Estimates and running a job: crew leads. Deck consults: design advisors. Electrical, gas and concrete work: licensed subcontractors.
pf.services.nobody_home: Estimates, cleaning and sealing: nobody needs to be home if the gate is open. Build days: an adult on the booking is reachable by phone.
pf.services.online: No video or phone deck consult: it uses the samples at the showroom
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest job taken, with smaller requests pointed elsewhere (the example takes no new deck under 100 square feet).

after_time: Who will sign the contract? Everyone on the deed should be at the estimate visit

pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property, or someone with the owner's written OK. A renter's job needs the owner to sign.
studio: Which area, and a rough budget (on the secure page)

stop.words: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: no booking; a new request must say the home was made safe

stop.words: a deck, balcony or stair giving way or pulling away from the house, with people on it
stop.says: Get everyone off it and away from under it, and call 911 if anyone is hurt.

steps_then_go_on.words: soft or rotted boards, a wobbly railing, loose stairs
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep people off that part and away from the railing until the crew lead has looked at it.

steps_then_go_on.words: a wasp nest or a sink hole under the old deck
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep clear of it. We'll look at it first.

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about whether a deck can hold a hot tub, or about the house wall it attaches to, go to the business's own line

after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one

pf.visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Showroom: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator measures the deck area and the house wall, probes the ground, and photographs; the written quote follows within 3 business days, good for 30 days
pf.visit.changes: A written change order, priced and signed by both, before any changed work. Rotted joists, a buried line moved, or a bigger footprint are priced this way.
pf.visit.outside_checks: A footing check before the concrete, a frame check before the decking, and a final check, where the permit requires them
pf.visit.done: The final check where needed, then the walk-through and punch list, then DONE on the last work day; the care notes go with it
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the consult, with the design advisor's notes and the picks saved for the estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: The old deck or the yard, the house wall, and anything nearby that could be hit (steps, sprinklers, fences, a patio)

pf.money.estimate: The example's $89 estimate visit is credited to the job; billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On project work, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone on the deed
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.stages: Each stage is billed only when it's done and any check has passed: the start, the frame and decking, the finish. Never ahead of the work
pf.money.last_payment: After the walk-through and the final check
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the next stage bill
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the crew lead texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: The 3D deck preview's $55 is credited to the job if Alex signs; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Crew leads (Gabe, Rhys): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the crew. Design advisors (Ines, Kofi) at the showroom.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another crew lead may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its crew lead unless Sam moves it

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.final: The final check and any permit sign-off before the last payment
pf.rules.lien_waivers: Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: 1 year on workmanship (the example's); makers' warranties on boards, railings and hardware. Wood checks, moves and fades as it weathers; that is not a defect, and the contract says what is covered.

pf.edges.weather: Rain or a soaked yard on a footing day, or rain on a staining day: the day moves, with no fee; the crew lead checks the forecast the day before
pf.edges.materials_late: Boards, composite or railing kits are late: wait, or switch to an in-stock item with the owner's yes, or move the day, with no fee to the customer
pf.edges.association_late: The owners' association is slow: the start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.hidden_conditions: Rotted joists, a rotted house rim board or rock found when the old deck comes off or a footing is dug: a change order before the fix
pf.edges.line_in_the_way: A marked utility line is in the way: the crew plans around it; the start may move a day or two
pf.edges.permit_late: The start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait
pf.edges.wood_movement: New wood checks, cups and fades as it dries; the quote says so
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.nobody_home: Estimates, cleaning and sealing with the gate open, with start and end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project; refitted that morning, not edited): an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts: documents, stages, photos, extrawork, firststeps, multiday, banktransfer; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booking is the $89 estimate visit, credited to the job; Gabe's written quote; the contract signed by everyone on the deed; $1,600 to start, $9,600 when the frame passes its inspection and the decking is down, $4,800 at the finish (a $16,000 deck build). The $89 keeps the master's numbers true; a free estimate is the owner's choice (pf.money).
B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, photos|deposit|bill (Stair rebuild, $640 from photos, a $160 deposit, a $480 rest). Left out: list paths. Deck cleaning ($179) and Deck sealing ($150) are in pf.services, but the master's booking cards name one list service, so a list path would show the wrong name (MASTER).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Deck Studio, a deck and patio showroom (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|card|counter: a $35 deck consult with Ines, a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee, paid at the showroom desk. The other three: list|none|counter, list|full|none (3D deck preview, $55, credited to the job if Alex signs), list|deposit|counter (deck design package, $140, $40 deposit).
Flow A has no video or phone consult: the deck consult uses the sample boards and railings at the showroom (the A4-01 video branch is hidden because the fact `video` is not listed).
Own steps: A8-x01 (the deck consult offers the estimate visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the permit and the utility locate go first, with the owners' association's OK where there is one; a late permit moves the start with no fee; a marked line near a footing means a new footing layout) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (rotted joists found where the new frame meets the house: a change order first, signed by both).
A deck is built on footings and attached to the house, so the first steps are the locate (before any footing is dug), the permit and the association's OK (pf.first_steps), inspections run at the footings, the frame and the end (pf.visit outside_checks), and the quote says that wood moves and fades (pf.edges wood_movement). Stop words: a gas smell or sparking wires; a deck, balcony or stair giving way or pulling away from the house with people on it. Soft boards and a wobbly railing are a go-on with 'keep people off that part'.
Dates run forward: cancel window ends Tue Oct 27; permit and locate to-do Wed Oct 28 'due before the first work day, Mon Nov 2'; a late permit Fri Oct 30 with new starts Mon Nov 9 / Mon Nov 16; the line re-plan Thu Oct 29; the work days Mon Nov 2 to Fri Nov 6 (or Nov 9 to 13) and the change order Tue Nov 3.
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now (S2-30 'Yes' branch off, no `sentnow` fact), so nobody is on call. After turning it off, the joined text was searched for the opposite claim: S2-30's 'Neither deck building nor the showroom takes jobs sent now' and S1-21's 'Jobs sent now: None: every job is booked ahead' are re-worded; the other 'sent now' lines are the master's general rules for work that does send.
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 (as the parent).
Self-checks: (1) the opposite-claim search above; (2) every example message was searched for this work's stop words (they appear only in the danger-words line and the plug-in); (3) B3-11 and B3-18 read as one Spanish conversation: the caller describes a go-on case, is asked about injury and gas, answers no, and gets the safety steps.
Names: Gabe and Rhys are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Ines and Kofi the design advisors (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 230 Sawyer Rd (the company), 31 Harbor St (the showroom), 55 Willow Ct (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (EX-1042, EX-2087, EX-3150, EX-4216, EX-5309), also in place of the master's S2-21 person licenses.
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown. No state, city or number from one.
